definition: Aaron Courville is the co-author of the 'Deep Learning' textbook and Professor at Mila.
details: Co-authored the canonical 'Deep Learning' textbook (with Goodfellow and Bengio), co-authored the original GAN paper, and researches RL and multimodal AI.

explainer.lead: Aaron Courville is a deep learning researcher, a professor at Université de Montréal and a founding member of Mila, who co-wrote the standard textbook Deep Learning.
explainer.knownFor: Co-writing Deep Learning (MIT Press, 2016) with Ian Goodfellow and Yoshua Bengio, and co-authoring the original generative adversarial networks paper.

contributions.name: The Deep Learning textbook
contributions.detail: An 800-page introduction to the maths, techniques and research frontiers of deep learning, free to read online and used in courses worldwide.

contributions.name: Generative adversarial networks
contributions.detail: Co-author of the 2014 paper that introduced GANs, where a generator and a discriminator are trained against each other.

contributions.name: Building Mila
contributions.detail: A founding member of Mila – Quebec Artificial Intelligence Institute, one of the largest deep learning research centres.

contributions.name: Research
contributions.detail: Probabilistic and generative models, representation learning, computer vision, language, reinforcement learning and multi-agent games.

contributions.name: Leadership
contributions.detail: Canada CIFAR AI Chair, CIFAR fellow in Learning in Machines & Brains, and scientific director of IVADO.

timeline.what: PhD, Robotics Institute, Carnegie Mellon University
Deep Learning is published by MIT Press
